question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Confiscate
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Confiscate"** means to take or seize someone's property with authority. (ज़ब्त करना)

 
 
• **Example: **The police **confiscated** the illegal drugs during the raid.
 
 
 
• **"Seize" **refers to taking hold of something suddenly and forcibly. (पकड़ना)
 
 
• **Example: **The customs officers** seized **the contraband at the airport.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'confiscate' **is **'seize'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Yield **(समर्पण करना): To give way to arguments, demands, or pressure.

 
 
• **Example:** The government will not yield to terrorist demands.
 
 
 
• **Release **(रिहा करना): To allow or enable to escape from confinement.
 
 
• **Example: **The prisoners were released after serving their sentences.
 
 
 
• **Sprint** (तेज़ दौड़): To run at full speed over a short distance.
 
 
• **Example:** He sprinted to catch the bus.
